instruction: Plug the charger into the power strip.

arguments.note: The charger lies flat with its pins toward the near edge. I will approach its body from above, leaving the pins clear.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I am positioning above the charger for a side-to-side body grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 24 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The charger is left and forward of the hand in the wrist view. I will center over it while descending to a safe approach height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is centered laterally. I will lower above its body and check the remaining alignment before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The close view shows the charger behind the grasp center. I will shift toward the near edge while maintaining clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The body is between the jaws with the pins clear. I will lower to engage its sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will close on the charger body, keeping the exposed pins outside the jaws.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have closed against the charger body. I will lift it clear before turning the pins downward.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger lifted securely. I will begin rotating its pins toward the socket plane.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will finish making the charger upright with its pins pointing down.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 33 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The rotation stopped short; I will finish the remaining fifteen degrees before transporting the charger.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 18 waypoints (0.7s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is upright. I will carry it across free space toward the power strip.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will use the idle wrist to inspect the socket alignment from above.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 23 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will complete the overhead viewing pose to see the socket holes clearly.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 25 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will bring the upright charger above the middle socket, still well clear of the strip.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The socket pairs are angled relative to the table edge. I will match the charger blade spacing to that angle before descending.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will approach the middle socket with the pins still above the strip, then refine the alignment from the overhead view.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The pins are above the middle socket but slightly right of its paired slots. I will lower closer and correct that lateral offset.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both blades now line up laterally with the paired slots. I will descend five millimetres and check the contact alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The blade tips remain aligned over the openings. I will lower another three millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will ease the aligned blades into the socket with another small downward motion.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The descent stopped short, suggesting the tips are touching the socket rim. I will lift slightly and shift three millimetres toward the slot centers.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will test the corrected alignment with a four-millimetre descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The tips appear within the paired openings. I will continue downward by three millimetres to seat them.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is descending into the slots without a large tracking error. I will seat it another three millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Only a small gap remains beneath the charger body. I will lower three millimetres toward full seating.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will make a final three-millimetre seating motion before releasing the charger.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger body is now seated against the strip. I will release it without moving the hand.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The released charger remains upright in the socket. I will withdraw the open jaws clear of it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger is seated and stable. I will return the working arm toward its starting position.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: I will restore the left arm's starting position and orientation.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The combined return was refused. I will take a shorter translation first, keeping the current orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 25 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The left arm is near home. I will rotate the observation wrist back toward its initial orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will translate the idle arm back to its initial grasp-point position before completing its rotation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The charger remains fully upright in the strip. I will restore the right arm's starting orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
